front.title: Figure Statements: A SCITT Profile for Published Figures Given to AI Agents

abstract.t:
Profiles of SCITT for AI agents record what an agent did: which tool it called, under whose authority, and what bytes came back. They state, correctly, that they do not show whether those bytes were true. This document profiles the layer underneath: a Signed Statement, issued by the publisher of a figure, that binds the figure to its source, period and population, and that is superseded when the publisher corrects the figure or when the original source prints a different value in a later edition. It also defines a short token that travels with the figure through tool results and prose, so that a later reader can find the statement and learn whether the figure is still the one published.
The profile makes a narrow claim. It shows that a figure is the one a named publisher published, from a named source, and whether it has changed since. It does not show that the figure is correct.
